purpose: Compile the reviewed internal C14 component and independent fake-target harness using the already installed tools, retaining object/listing/image artifacts before any image execution.
required_before_binding: Retain and resolve the first independent C/header source review with named successors for any corrections.
Freeze the independent literal expectations and C fake-target tests before observing a subject result.
Independently review exact source/header/tests/build driver and this preparation; no subject execution during that review.
Pin selected source/header/tests/expectations/reviews/driver, installed compiler/linker, toolchain probe and filtered build environment in a separate Root binding.

proposed_build.clock_scope: Timer starts after exact input checks and exclusive output reservation. Interpreter startup, preflight and final report write are excluded; no production295/300-second clock or full-process fit claim.
proposed_build.SDK: Existing Windows SDK10.0.26100.0, MSVC14.51.36231 and UCRT; external trusted build prerequisites, no complete fresh header/source restoration or attestation claim.
proposed_build.raw_component: C11 x64 /O2 /Ob0 /Oi /MT /W4 /WX /GL- /GS- with machine/source assembly listing. Raw component omits stack-cookie callbacks; source has no variable-sized stack data. Exact compiled ordering remains to review.
proposed_build.test_harness: Separate own-source C11 translation unit; same flags except /GS; fake targets only, no model/clinical files.
proposed_build.link: x64 console, no incremental link; own objects plus standard installed CRT/kernel32 toolchain dependencies.
proposed_build.output: Fresh exclusive data/cache/r09-native-carrier-component-build-* directory under D:; ordinary trusted-harness evidence writes, not production physical14 publication.
proposed_build.commands: Exactly compile-carrier, compile-tests, link-tests. No resulting executable dispatch in this phase.
proposed_build.failure: Retain first command result, stdout/stderr, chained journal and terminal report. No retry or source edit in-place. Known subprocesses killed/reaped on failure; OS-wide descendant behavior is not attested.

post_build_gate: Independently review complete layout assertions, object/listing/linked-image hashes and exact fourteen post-return scalar store/error transport/publication paths. Only then may Root bind one separate fake-target execution; passing compilation is not a native/ABI behavior result.
excluded: No real fourteen-port targets, original payloads, live kernel ticket/lease/child/path binding, model execution, old native replay, cap/default/downloader/monitor changes or scientific claim.
